name: Calcium- and cAMP-driven CREB phosphorylation and CAMKK-AMPK signaling
rationale: All members concern CaMK/adenylate cyclase kinase cascades relaying postsynaptic calcium to CREB or AMPK, lacking the NMDA/AMPA receptor, LTP and memory members of C1/C2/C4 and the PKA-only focus of C3.

core: FGFR downstream cascades and activating mutants
name: FGFR2/FGFR3 cascades and activating FGFR point mutants
rationale: Members are FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and ligand activation for FGFR2 and FGFR3 plus oncogenic FGFR1-4 point mutants, whereas confusables centre on FGFR1, FGFR1/2 ligand binding or FGF signaling regulators.

core: Myeloid inflammatory chemokine and cytokine production
name: Myeloid inflammatory chemokine production and its negative regulation
rationale: Members describe pro-inflammatory chemokine/cytokine output of myeloid cells (IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1, macrophage cytokines) and its restraint, unlike confusables about leukocyte adhesion/extravasation, lymphocyte cytokines or monocyte chemotaxis.

core: Responses to drugs of abuse and reward learning
name: Nicotine, alcohol and psychostimulant responses and reward learning
rationale: Members are behavioral/cellular responses to nicotine, ethanol, cocaine, amphetamine and opioids plus conditioning/place preference, distinguished from confusables on neuropeptides, social behavior and dopamine receptor signaling by the nicotine and alcohol members.

core: Viral RNA synthesis and translation in the host cell
name: Influenza vRNP assembly, viral RNA synthesis and translation
rationale: Members cover influenza-style nuclear vRNP complexes, viral mRNA/vRNA synthesis, viral translation and NS1-type host mRNA-processing inhibition, distinguishing it from coronavirus replicase/host-translation and retroviral/HCMV confusables.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism and catabolism (including phenylketonuria) with general L-amino acid catabolic terms, distinguished from histidine/threonine, proline/glycine and BH4 confusables.

qualifier: collagen, elastic fibre and basement membrane
name: Collagen, elastic fibre and basement membrane assembly
rationale: Members concern collagen biosynthesis, trimerization, crosslinking and fibril organization, elastic fibres, laminin and basement membrane assembly, whereas confusables emphasise integrin/collagen-receptor signaling, hemidesmosomes, fibronectin or proteoglycans.

core: Removal of methyl and alkyl groups from DNA
name: Direct DNA dealkylation and demethylation with methionine salvage
rationale: Members are direct alkylation-damage reversal (MGMT, ALKBH2/3), TET/TDG 5-methylcytosine demethylation and methylthioadenosine-to-methionine salvage, the last being what separates it from base-excision repair confusables.

core: Host-virus control of viral RNA replication and translation
name: Viral RNA replication, translation control and host nucleic-acid editing
rationale: Members span coronavirus replication and host-translation modulation, translational repression and host antiviral restriction, with APOBEC3G/ADAR deamination and editing distinguishing it from HIV-entry, influenza and viral-replication-regulation confusables.

qualifier: cationic and neutral, with inherited transporter defects
name: Cationic and neutral amino acid transport and its defects
rationale: Members are transport of lysine, arginine, ornithine and neutral/aromatic amino acids plus SLC7A7, SLC25A15, SLC6A14 and SLC22A18 defects, the cationic members and diseases separating it from oligopeptide, polyamine and proton-coupled transport confusables.

qualifier: defective factor VIII, IX and V variants
name: Coagulation cascade and defective factor VIII, IX and V
rationale: Members are coagulation initiation, intrinsic/common pathway and fibrin formation plus many defective F8, F9 and FV variants, the latter absent from the fibrinolysis, platelet and VWF confusables.

qualifier: and inhibitory control of phagocyte activation
name: CSF1 signaling and restraint of macrophage and neutrophil activation
rationale: Members centre on M-CSF signaling, macrophage proliferation, myeloid identity and SIRP-type inhibition of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, which separate it from IL-6, DAP12 and CSF-production/differentiation confusables.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and early elongation
name: RNA polymerase II initiation, promoter escape and early elongation
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter opening and escape (cellular and HIV promoters), early elongation complex formation and pausing, separating it from termination/PIC-assembly, CTD-capping and Tat-dependent HIV elongation confusables.

name: Sperm flagellar motility and mitochondrial sheath assembly
rationale: Members concern sperm motility, cilium beating and sperm mitochondrial sheath organization (plus Sertoli barrier), unlike confusables on acrosome/fertilization, germ cell development, axoneme assembly or airway motile cilia.

core: Sister chromatid cohesion and mitotic progression
qualifier: PLK1/Aurora A/NEK mitotic kinases and spindle checkpoint
name: Sister chromatid cohesion and PLK1/Aurora A mitotic entry
rationale: Members span establishment, maintenance and resolution of centromeric cohesion with PLK1, Aurora A and NEK kinase control of mitotic entry and spindle checkpoint, distinct from APC/C-driven mitotic exit and spindle midzone/cytokinesis confusables.

name: Death receptor-mediated extrinsic apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members are Fas/TRAIL/TNF/TRIF caspase-8, c-FLIP, BID and RIPK1 necroptosis signaling and its regulation, distinguishing it from mitochondrial intrinsic apoptosis and T-cell/tumour-defense confusables.

qualifier: Tat-dependent and Tat-independent pausing and arrest
name: HIV-1 transcription elongation, pausing and Tat regulation
rationale: All members describe HIV elongation complex formation, pausing and arrest/recovery with or without Tat and Tat-host interactions, whereas confusables are host RNA Pol II initiation and generic elongation regulation.

qualifier: histone and non-histone targets, including demethylation
name: Histone and non-histone arginine and lysine methylation
rationale: Members are peptidyl-arginine and lysine mono/di/trimethylation, histone arginine methylation and demethylation and TP53 methylation, distinguishing it from confusables on PRC2/MLL/NuRD/BAF chromatin complexes and DNA methylation.

name: Regulation of keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis
rationale: All four members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation or apoptosis, unlike confusables on cornification/skin barrier, wound-healing migration or hair follicle and melanocyte development.

name: Cardiac action potential plateau and repolarization
rationale: Members are action potential phases 1-3 and atrial/ventricular repolarization (plus AV node depolarization), separating it from conduction-system depolarization and phase-4/potassium channel confusables.

name: Pausing and arrest recovery of HIV transcription elongation
rationale: All three members describe pausing or arrest and recovery of HIV elongation (with or without Tat), whereas confusables cover elongation complex formation, initiation or generic Pol II elongation.

name: Cysteinyl leukotriene biosynthesis and transport
rationale: Members concern leukotriene/LTD4 synthesis, leukotriene transport and LTC4-CysLTR signaling, distinct from LTB4/icosanoid catabolism, lipoxin and GPCR receptor confusables.

qualifier: Cdc20-bound, with APC/C phosphorylation and inhibition
name: APC/C-Cdc20 activity and substrate degradation in mitosis
rationale: Members are APC/C phosphorylation and inhibition and APC/C:Cdc20 degradation of cyclin B, securin and Nek2A controlling mitotic exit, separating it from Cdh1-centred late-mitosis/G1 confusables.

name: IL-6 signaling with ERK1/ERK2 activation
rationale: Members are IL-6/JAK-STAT3 signaling, its negative regulation and MAPK1/MAPK3 activation, distinguished from ERK inactivation, IL-10/IL-27, CSF1 and interferon-gamma confusables.

qualifier: phosphate transport, vitamin D and vitamin K
name: Phosphate homeostasis, vitamin D/K metabolism and tissue mineralization
rationale: Members span phosphate transport and its defects, vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism, gamma-carboxylation, FGF23-Klotho/PTH signaling and bone/tooth mineralization, unlike bicarbonate/pH, steroidogenesis, odontogenesis and retinoid confusables.
